intents.description: Customer reports a package that is late, not delivered, delivered to the wrong address, marked delivered incorrectly, or otherwise missing.
Customer receives the wrong product, a damaged, broken, or defective item, or a package that was opened or left in poor condition.
Customer disputes charged delivery fees, eligibility for free shipping, or unexpected shipping costs.
Problems placing an order such as address not updating, payment method issues, checkout errors, or needing to cancel/change an order.
Issues with initiating, scheduling, or completing a return including pickup problems, missing return labels, or self‑return errors.
Customer has been promised a refund (for a cancelled order, returned item, or other reason) but has not received it yet.
Customer received a refund for the wrong item, refund was denied after a return, or there is a dispute over the amount.
Login problems, password resets, two‑step verification failures, locked or hacked accounts, or inability to use email/phone linked to the account.
Requests to permanently close, delete, or reopen an Amazon account.
Questions or complaints about Prime subscription charges, auto‑renewal, cancellation, missing benefits, or refunds for unwanted Prime.
Technical problems with Amazon hardware (Echo, Fire TV, Kindle, etc.) or related apps, including warranty disputes.
Problems playing Prime Video or other streaming content such as buffering, playback errors, missing episodes, or audio issues.
Reports of suspected counterfeit, fake, or unauthentic products sold on Amazon.
Customer sees incorrect pricing, false discounts, overcharges, or price changes after purchase.
Questions about gift card status, fraud, usage, or promotional credits and rewards not received.
Reports of suspicious emails, messages, or scams claiming to be from Amazon.
Seller not responding, disputes over product quality, returns, refunds, or suspected seller scams.
International orders stuck in customs or requiring KYC verification.
Problems changing wishlists, language/search preferences, or other account settings.
Difficulty reaching Amazon support, lack of response, request for callbacks, or language barrier with support.
